name: graph_palette_kinds
description: UX-3, decision 1: the Graph palette places the render nodes whose ports follow their parameters, each seeded so the engine takes it as placed. From a Blank project, New render target... declares ux3_scene with only a name. In the Graph tab the palette's render.target_ref offers the declared targets in a combo: picking ux3_scene places ux3_scene_ref, its type read off the declaration. render.raster arrives drawing the engine's passthrough over three vertices into an image of its own, and the frame plan runs it. render.snapshot_copy offers the plan's passes: after render_raster, it copies what the raster pass wrote into an image shaped like it, and the frame plan runs the copy. Nothing is typed but the project's and the target's names.
